entries.description: Read-only MCP server for Strat AI, a market analysis and pre-trade risk adjudication terminal for Indian equities and Futures & Options (NSE/BSE). Exposes product scope, deterministic risk rules, live pricing, product areas and documentation search, plus MCP Apps ui:// views that render inline in conversation. No authentication required.
representativeQueries: is my stop loss wide enough for this NSE trade
what does Strat AI cost per month
tools for analysing Nifty and Bank Nifty option chains
how do I check reward to risk before placing an intraday trade
pre-trade risk audit for Indian F&O

entries.description: When to use Strat AI and when to route elsewhere, plus WebMCP and MCP tool schemas, call examples, and the rules an agent should follow when representing Strat AI to a user.
representativeQueries: when should an agent use Strat AI
how do I call the Strat AI tools

entries.description: Navigation index for AI readers: what Strat AI is, the jobs it is best fit for, what it explicitly does not do, and links to every key page and machine-readable surface on the domain.
representativeQueries: summarise the stratai.live website for me

entries.description: Tools registered on document.modelContext across stratai.live, callable by a browser-resident agent: get_product_overview, get_risk_rules, get_pricing_plans, list_features, search_documentation, join_private_beta and submit_contact_inquiry.
representativeQueries: register me for the Strat AI private beta
send an inquiry to the Strat AI team
